integrity: Analytic proof and a standalone finite-state exact-rational checker. Numerical asymptotic tests are supplementary evidence, not proof. No external or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform Bell-pair selection, matching-family states, 0<p<1, and fixed p with macroscopic cuts for thermodynamic limits. Established monomer-dimer theory covers some static ingredients; possible broader unindexed counting-statistics coverage remains a publication-priority risk. No cut-entropy CLT claimed.
title: Exact stationary cut-entanglement statistics for all-to-all Bell measurements
